gst.title: GST — HSN summary
gst.subtitle: HSN-wise summary of outward supplies, for GSTR-1 Table 12.
gst.help1: For every HSN code you sold in the period: how many packs, the value net of GST, and the GST on it. That is what Table 12 of GSTR-1 asks for, and it cannot be worked out from the tax rate alone — 5% covers many different headings.
gst.help2Prefix: Figures come from the codes stored on each order line at the time of sale, so re-classifying a product today never changes a period you have already filed.
gst.help2Strong: Cancelled and deleted orders are excluded.
gst.help2Middle: Refunds are shown separately and are
gst.help2Suffix: subtracted — a refund is a credit note and belongs in Table 9B, not here.
gst.help3Prefix: Every GST column here is tax
gst.help3Suffix: on your outward supplies. It is not what you pay: that is this less the input credit on everything you bought, which this system doesn't track. Take these numbers into your accounting software and settle the liability there.
gst.unclassifiedHint: Their sales appear below under "NOT CLASSIFIED". Set a code on each from the product form.
gst.mismatch_one: {{count}} product charges a rate that differs from its HSN code
gst.mismatch_other: {{count}} products charge a rate that differs from their HSN code
gst.mismatchHint: Published rates as of {{date}}. This can be deliberate — check each one and change the rate on the product form if it isn't.
gst.refundsNotePrefix: Refunds recorded in this period (credit notes — reported in Table 9B,
gst.refundsNoteSuffix: netted off above): {{amount}}, including GST of {{tax}}.
gst.fallbackTitle: Some invoices used a fallback state
gst.fallbackBody: State could not be read from the address; billed as Madhya Pradesh.

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: Find a customer by name, phone, or email to see their orders.
customers.pageHelp: Read-only — useful when a customer calls and you want their order history in front of you. You cannot see or reset anyone's password: tell them to use "Forgot password" on the store, which emails them an OTP.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.subtitle: Create and manage discount codes
coupons.pageHelp: A coupon is either a percentage or a flat ₹ amount off the items. It is applied before delivery is added, so a big coupon can push the order under the free-delivery threshold and put the delivery fee back. To stop a coupon, switch it off — don't delete it, or you lose the record on past orders. If a customer says a code won't apply, check it in "Check a Code" below.
coupons.checkHint: Verify a code exists and is redeemable (active, not expired, under its usage limit). Customer restrictions and minimum-order amounts are reported but not treated as failures — they depend on who is buying.
coupons.codeHint: Will be automatically converted to uppercase
coupons.amountHint: Flat ₹ off, capped at the order subtotal
coupons.maxUsesHintEditing: Redeemed {{count}} time(s) so far. Set 1 for a single-use coupon.
coupons.maxUsesHintNew: Total redemptions across all customers. Set 1 for a single-use coupon.
coupons.validUntilHint: Leave empty for no expiry date
coupons.restrictHint: Leave empty and any customer can redeem the code. Pick someone and only that account can — everyone else is told the coupon isn't available to them.
coupons.invalidPercent: A percentage coupon needs a whole number between 1 and 100.
coupons.invalidFixed: A fixed coupon needs a positive ₹ amount.
coupons.validPlain: This coupon exists, is active, and is redeemable.

recycleBin.title: Recycle Bin
recycleBin.subtitle: Restore deactivated products & combos, and soft-deleted orders.
recycleBin.pageHelp: Anything that stays here past its countdown is protected, not stuck: a product that appears on a past order, or an order that already has a tax invoice, is never purged — the bills behind it have to keep working.
recycleBin.retentionTitle: Items are deleted permanently after {{days}} days
recycleBin.retentionBody: Anything moved here is kept for {{days}} days from the day you delete it, then removed for good and cannot be recovered. The countdown is per item, so restore anything you want to keep before its {{days}} days are up.

adminInfo.title: Account Settings
adminInfo.subtitle: Manage your profile and payment details
adminInfo.pageHelp: These details are what customers see and what the UPI QR is built from. They do NOT control where Razorpay settles your money — that bank account lives in the Razorpay dashboard under Account & Settings → Banking, and changing it here will not move a rupee.
adminInfo.paymentDescription: Your UPI and bank account for receiving payments

contact.title: Contact Submissions
contact.subtitle: Manage messages from the contact form
contact.pageHelp: Chat needs an account, so this is the only way someone without one can reach you — check it once a day. "Reply" does not send anything: answer from your own email or WhatsApp, then use it to note what you said and mark the message handled.
contact.replyDescription: Add notes about your reply. This will also mark the submission as replied.
contact.replyPlaceholder: e.g., Replied via email on 25 Dec…
